messages:
DeployBot: Starting deploy to production (prod-us-east-1)
DeployBot: tag=v3.12.0, image=redwood/inference:3.12.0, rollout=canary(10%), initiated_by=@alice

alice: kicking off canary now. monitoring dashboards + release notes at https://confluence.redwood.ai/releases/v3.12.0
alice: will keep an eye on latency/error-rate for first 10 minutes

CI-Gate: CI Gate update: 3 checks failed out of 24 -> integration-tests, migrations-smoke, eslint
CI-Gate: Failure summary: integration-tests: 1 failing test, migrations-smoke: migration_2026_add_idx failed (duplicate key), eslint: 12 lint errors in pkg/cli

dev-mig: looking at migration logs: `ERROR: duplicate key value violates unique constraint "users_email_key"` at migration_2026_add_idx.sql:42
dev-mig: that migration touches a rarely-run path, might be data-dependent; adding quick check script now

qa-lead: I can reproduce migrations-smoke locally with current staging DB dump. not from application code changes in this PR set (suspect older data).

eng-release: options: 1) rollback to v3.11.9 (pin and abort rollout), 2) attempt hotfix + rerun CI (riskier but avoids rollback), 3) pin canary to last-known-good commit and continue partial rollout. Need decision fast; change window ends in 40m.

bob: my vote: pin/rollback to v3.11.9. migrations failing are risky for prod. we should avoid partial inconsistent schema states. +1 rollback

carol: prefer try-rerun after narrow hotfix (lint easy, migration seems data-related). if dev-mig can confirm migration is safe with a guard, we can rerun. +1 rerun if guard added

sre-oncall: from SRE POV, rollback safest to meet SLA. If we roll forward, we need tight monitoring and an automatic abort rule. we don't want cascading errors during peak traffic.

alice: quick poll — thumbs up to rollback (bob, sre-oncall), thumbs up to attempt hotfix+rerun (carol). @eng-release any preference?

eng-release: leaning rollback given the migration touching uniqueness constraints. can prepare pinned release and coordinate DB safe-guarding during rollback.

CI-Gate: Rerun requested by @alice for build #3456 -> queued. (Note: rerun won't fix migration data issues without code guard)

DeployBot: Deploy blocked: CI gate failed. Canary rollout paused at 10%. Manual-unblock required to continue.

alice: okay, prepare rollback plan. @sre-oncall and @eng-release, can you coordinate the rollback window and notify infra? I'll hold the manual-unblock button until we confirm plan.

sre-oncall: starting rollback checklist now — will open incident bridge if needed and schedule the pin back to v3.11.9. ETA ~12 min to pin and verify health metrics.

eng-release: creating rollback PR to pin tag and trigger deploy cancellation. will post link in channel when ready.

DeployBot: Note: once pinned, automated canary resume will require a successful CI Gate. Manual overrides are logged and will require two approvers.

alice: thanks team. rolling back for safety. please post any follow-ups on the rollback thread.
